title: Nutritious Smoky Irish Lamb Pie
description: A hearty and comforting Irish dish featuring smoky lamb and a glassy jelly crust, perfect for a sick day. This nut-free-friendly recipe is enclosed in a flaky pastry crust.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cold butter to the bowl and use a pastry blender to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the ice-cold water to the bowl, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead it a few times until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough in half and roll out each half into a circle that is about 1/8-inch thick.
In a large bowl, combine the lamb, gravy granules, and red currant jelly, and mix until the lamb is evenly coated.
Spoon the lamb mixture into the center of one of the dough circles, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg and place the second dough circle on top of the filling.
Crimp the edges of the dough to seal the pie and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
